From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 07 Oct 2025 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Initiate vendor directory: legal details + PO onramp

Alex —

Thanks for the call this morning. To get Volaris set up in our vendor directory and allow Procurement to route POs, we need a few items captured and the onboarding form completed. Below is the checklist + what we need from you to keep the momentum going. If you prefer, reply with attachments and I’ll drop them into the vendor portal.

Required (please return as PDFs where applicable):
- Legal entity name (exact legal name for master record)
- Proof of registration or certificate of formation (country/state)
- Remittance address (street, city, postal code)
- Primary AP contact name, email, and phone (this is who will receive PO/INVOICE routing)
- Tax ID (EIN or VAT) and tax classification (US: W-9 / Non-US: W-8/other)
- Bank details for ACH/Wire (bank name, account name, routing/IBAN, SWIFT) — we store these in a secure supplier vault
- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached template) + signed W-9 if US entity

Optional but helpful:
- Preferred PO contact (if different from AP)
- Remittance email address for e-invoicing (if you support it)
- Any purchase order terms that differ from our standard (lead time, ship-to exceptions)

Attachments: I’ve attached our supplier onboarding template (Volaris_Entity_Form_20251007.pdf). Please fill, sign where indicated, and return. Once we receive the packet our Vendor Admin will verify and provision a vendor ID; Procurement will then confirm PO coding and next steps.

Timeline: ideally we get the completed packet by EOD Wednesday 10/08 to provision before next week’s purchasing batch.

If you have any questions about which tax form to use or need a secure upload link, tell me and I’ll coordinate with Finance.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Volaris into the system.

—
Soojin Lee
Vendor Onboarding Lead
